name: cat_cru_solo128
refs: the small black cat in a purple witch hat and cape with purple eyes: keep its design, colors and pixel size exactly
the crucified pose and the pink goo on the wrists, ankles and body to follow
desc: Pixel art, only the small black witch cat, no other character, transparent background. The cat is drawn in three-quarter view turned to face LEFT: its face and body point toward the left side of the image, its right shoulder nearer to the viewer. It is pinned flat against an invisible wall behind it, its back pressed against it, both arms spread wide out to the sides and a little raised, wrists stuck in blobs of glossy pink goo, legs dangling with the ankles stuck in pink goo. Pink paint goo with yellow streaks is smeared over its cape and body and drips down. Eyes squeezed shut, mouth open, struggling. The cat fills the frame like the reference sprite.
